corrections.reason: Distinguish ten-day duration from tenth calendar date; nominative and punctuation.
Interrogative which rather than among-which or relative pronoun; attributive context still needed.
What kind rather than merely what thing.
Singular personal name rather than plural/inflected German and Ukrainian object title.
Remove repeated synonym and erroneous question mark.

flags.reason: Japanese door does not inherently guarantee one architectural style; do not require Japanese-vs-Western contrast without a clear picture.
Existing counter hold retained; degree becomes university degree and counter becomes desk/opposition.
トイレ is toilet/restroom, not necessarily a bathing room; avoid false bath-room sense in location questions.
By all means idiom becomes by every method/at any cost; use permission/invitation example.
Thank-you, vague somehow, and concessive meanings of どうも need separate sentence contexts.
Distant adjective mixed with motion/location adverb and duplicated forms.
Spurious question punctuation and duplicated equivalent.
Nested English placeholders translated literally; choose which-way/which-one or polite-where context separately.
Physical direction confused with manner/how and person-who; explicit directional question needed.
Very does not necessarily mean excessively; remove unintended negative excess.
Japanese どの precedes a noun; standalone which-one and attributive which should use a complete noun phrase.
Take a class translated literally as take a cohort/object in ru/uk/el and Korean verb misspelled 얻으다; rewrite full example.
Dictionary take-photo/make-film verbs should not be purpose clauses; use conventional photograph/film collocations.
Dictionary animal-vocalization verb has unnecessary purpose marker.
Japanese cross-reference should be metadata, not answer text; Korean note contains Cyrillic у inside Japanese どうして.
Existing particle hold retained; etcetera requires examples in Japanese list construction.
Spurious question mark between duration/date alternatives.
Transitivity abbreviation is answer text; Greek παρατάσσω is transitive whereas Japanese is intransitive.
Arrange objects transitive verb incorrectly includes stand in a queue in many languages. Split from 574 and use an object.
Existing hold retained: Japanese 何 prefix needs a specified following noun/counter.
Lively/bustling place differs from personally busy/occupied; narrow to lively with place context.
Existing duration/calendar suffix hold retained; use concrete date or duration.
Lukewarm should not imply comfortably warm/affectionate diminutive; temperature context needs more precise target wording.
